request.description:
Create raw shifts for the specified contract ID. “Raw shifts” refers to uncategorized entries—simply submit the clock-in and clock-out times. The classification of those hours (e.g., regular or overtime) will be handled by the Deel platform.
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:write`

item.name: Delete a Shift by External ID

variable.description: (Required) The unique external identifier of the shift to be deleted.

request.description:
This endpoint deletes a shift using its external ID. Once deleted, the shift will no longer be retrievable or editable.
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:write`

response.name: Shift deleted successfully. No content is returned.

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier of the shift to retrieve.

request.description:
Retrieve details of a specific shift by external ID.
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:read`

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier of the shift to be updated.

request.description:
Update specific fields of an existing shift by its unique `external_id`. This includes shift summary details, description etc.
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:write`

item.name: Delete multiple shifts by External ID

request.description:
This endpoint deletes shifts using external IDs. Once deleted, the shifts will no longer be retrievable or editable.
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:write`
